units: probe readings (one multi-parameter pond probe reading each); parameter checks (one dissolved oxygen, pH, temperature, salinity or ammonia value checked against its band); total ammonia in mg/L

grains.RAW.FARMS: one row per fictional aquaculture farm (intensive shrimp pond, super-intensive shrimp raceway, pangasius pond, shrimp hatchery, recirculating nursery) in one of 6 Vietnam cities
grains.RAW.FARM_DAILY: one row per farm per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.EQUIPMENT_READINESS: one row per farm (paddlewheel aerator, air blower, water pump, backup generator or dissolved oxygen probe snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.wq_event_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(water quality event in next 7 days) per farm, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide probe-reading volume FORECAST; total ammonia ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.FARM_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic water quality response SOPs (one per farm type and cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.WATER_QUALITY_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.WATER_QUALITY_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, water quality event, cause and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (KPIs, daily in-band probe readings, water quality events by farm, event risk, IoT message count) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: IoT Core rule -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ALARM_ALERT logs new ALARM readings to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
